meta.title: English Studio | English lessons
meta.description: Private and group English lessons online, with a free level test.

home.title: Speak English with confidence
home.lead: Lessons built around your goal: conversation, IELTS, business English or starting from zero. With weekly homework, careful feedback and progress you can see.
home.levels: From beginner to advanced, on the European CEFR scale

steps.text: We talk about your goal and your schedule.

steps.text: Private or group, with the number of lessons you want.

steps.title: Start lessons
steps.text: Your class link and homework, in your panel.

packages.title: Packages
packages.lead: All lessons are online. Unused lessons stay yours until the package expires.
packages.emptyText: Tell me your goal and how often you want lessons, and I will suggest a plan and a price.

testCta.title: What is your level?
testCta.text: 30 grammar, vocabulary and reading questions, plus a short optional writing task. You see your result straight away and get it by email.

test.title: Find your English level
test.lead: A short test that gets harder or easier as you answer. At the end you see your level on the European CEFR scale.
test.resumeNote: Already started? The same button takes you back to where you stopped.

errors.rateLimited: Too many tests were started from this connection. Please try again in an hour.
errors.generic: The test could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.

test.unavailableTitle: The test is not ready yet
test.unavailableText: Questions are still being added. Send me a message and I will help you find your level.
test.note: The questions are in English and slowly get harder or easier with your answers. Your progress is saved: if you close the page, you continue from here.

writing.title: Optional: a short piece of writing
writing.lead: Writing shows things a multiple-choice test cannot. If you write a few lines, I will read them myself and send you a more exact level.
writing.label: Your answer, in English

result.title: Your estimated level
result.pendingWriting: I will read your writing and email you the final level.
result.emailNote: This result was also sent to your email.

A1.name: Beginner
A1.text: You understand and use very basic everyday phrases, and can introduce yourself and answer simple questions.

A2.name: Elementary
A2.text: You can handle short, simple exchanges about familiar things such as family, shopping and work.

B1.name: Intermediate
B1.text: You can deal with most everyday situations, describe experiences and plans, and explain your opinions simply.

B2.name: Upper intermediate
B2.text: You can talk and write in detail on many subjects and follow longer, more complex discussions.

C1.name: Advanced
C1.text: You use English flexibly and precisely for study, work and social life, and understand demanding texts.

C2.name: Proficient
C2.text: You understand almost everything you read or hear and express yourself with precision, even on complex topics.
